title: Sub Coverage Fire Drill Board
oneLiner: A school coverage planner that converts morning teacher absences into shareable sub plans, room moves, and panic-free handoffs.
signals: S7 Reddit r/SubstituteTeachers: sub day room/schedule mismatch
S8 Reddit r/Teachers: budget and shortage coverage scramble
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive operations web app called "Sub Coverage Fire Drill Board" for school administrators managing teacher absences. Build a fast morning-command workflow that converts absences into a coverage map, sub cards, missing-plan flags, room swaps, broadcasts, load balancing, and end-of-day incident notes. Required sections: absence intake, coverage map, panic flags, shareable sub cards, broadcast queue, admin load meter, and next-day repair list. Design direction: use the `field-ops` profile with reliable slate/steel styling, vivid action accents for urgent gaps, dense but legible planning surfaces, and touch-friendly controls for office staff under time pressure.
